about: Security-critical paths: keys, signing, identity, payments, spend caps, contracts. A diff touching any glob below, or adding/removing a line that matches a content marker, forces the verify-antseed 'keys, signing or spend caps' row and flags the PR (title prefix, body marker, `security-critical` label when the repo has it). Every path was checked to exist on origin/main c78e8bc54 (2026-10-18); scripts/security-check.mjs --audit re-checks that.

globs.why: node identity key persistence and the derived EVM wallet (verify-antseed keys row)
signed identity envelopes exchanged between peers
wire encoding of ReserveAuth/SpendingAuth/NeedAuth payment frames
payment frame routing between buyer and seller
EIP-712 SpendingAuth and ReserveAuth typed data (verify-antseed keys row)
buyer/seller payment managers, channel store, EVM clients, signatures (verify-antseed payments row)
seller-side required cumulative amount and 402 catch-up (verify-antseed payments row)
BuyerPaymentManager, negotiator, spend caps maxPerRequestUsdc / maxReserveAmountUsdc, USDC amounts (verify-antseed payments row)
Deposits, Channels, Staking: hold or move USDC on-chain
browser identity that signs typed data
desktop identity key handling (verify-antseed keys row; has no test)

content_markers.why: spend caps (verify-antseed keys row names them)
